message.content:
London is in the **Greenwich Mean Time (GMT)** zone during the winter months (roughly late October to late March).  
During the summer months (late March to late October) it switches to **British Summer Time (BST)**, which is GMT + 1 hour.

So:

| Season | Timezone | UTC offset |
|--------|----------|------------|
| Winter | GMT      | UTC + 0    |
| Summer | BST      | UTC + 1    |

If you need the exact current local time in London right now, let me know and I can fetch it for you.
